verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the search_agent call, which runs an AI agent loop that researches a single question and returns one answer. That implies the agent decides when it has enough, but the docs never describe adaptive crawling or sufficiency-based stopping. The max_credits cap only refuses requests whose estimate is too high, so it is a budget control, not adaptive stopping. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of adaptive crawl depth or an information-sufficiency stopping criterion, configurability of that behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
